blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consunji-led Concreat Holdings Philippines (CHP) said its two cement plants recover and reuse about 50 million liters of water annually, reducing their freshwater needs amid risks from prolonged dry spells and El Niño. The DMCI Holdings Inc. subsidiary uses water recycling and recovery systems at APO Cement in Naga, Cebu, and Solid Cement in Antipolo, Rizal. READ: Beyond Angat: Manila Water better prepared than ever for strong El Niño “Water conservation is not simply a response to periods of water scarcity.
